solution:
The correct option is** "corrective".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• It means to make something right that is wrong. 

 
 
• ** Example-*** She had corrective surgery on her knee.*
 
• ***Remedial*** means aimed at improving or correcting.
 
 
 
• ***Example-** The government took remedial actions to repair the bridge*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Superficial **means not thinking or doing something in a complete way.

 
 
• **Example -*** She has a superficial knowledge of her subject.*
 
 
 
• **Harmfu**l means causing harm.
 
 
• **Example **- *Fumes produced after burning plastic are harmful to human health.*
 
 
 
• **Medicinal** - useful for curing illness.
 
 
• ** Example:** *Medicinal plants are used to treat cancer.*
